mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 33 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Public Library, and keep your eyes peeled because the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 5:39 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling high in the sky toward the Fitchburg and Madison area.

The City of Verona has updated its zoning and sign ordinance, and residents are encouraged to verify their polling location as two new sites were added last year. Additionally, the Verona Police Department recently reported the arrest of a school bus driver on O W I charges.

Today you can head downtown to the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga is scheduled for this Sunday, followed by various trivia nights starting Monday at the Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On Thursday, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving while students were on board; no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently closed, but it opens today at 10:00 AM.
